clue.text: Manager hides a number showing emaciation

indicators.note: a manager who hides something keeps it tucked inside, so the boss word wraps round the number

parts.note: a manager is the boss
nine is a number

explanation.surface: A football manager concealing a squad number, somehow revealing how thin he is.
explanation.definitionFit: Emaciation is extreme thinness, when a person's skeleton shows through, hence bony-ness.

clue.text: Bishop, a laconic wit, makes one rock

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: laconic means brief, so the word for wit is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: salty talk is witty and racy

explanation.surface: A bishop with a dry sense of humour turns out to be a rock of reliability.
explanation.walkthrough: 'laconic' cuts SALTY (witty, racy) to SALT. 'makes' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Basalt is a dark volcanic stone, one particular kind of rock.

clue.text: Ninth gear disengaged leading to narrow escape

indicators.note: gears that are disengaged are thrown out of their mesh, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A driver slipping out of an implausible ninth gear just avoids a crash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disengaged' rearranges NINTHGEAR; 'leading to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A close call, where disaster was missed by a whisker, is an idiomatic near miss.

clue.text: Shortly climbing on top of Everest! That could be fatal

indicators.note: in a down entry, climbing means the word goes upwards, read from bottom to top

parts.note: shortly means soon

indicators.note: the top of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A mountaineer about to stand on the summit of Everest, which could prove deadly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climbing' turns SOON upwards to NOOS; 'top of' takes the E of Everest.
explanation.definitionFit: A hangman's loop round the neck is a deadly thing.

clue.text: Notice leaf oozing

parts.note: to notice is to see
a leaf of a book is a page

explanation.surface: Someone spots a leaf dripping with sap.
explanation.definitionFit: Seepage is liquid slowly leaking out, the noun sense of oozing.

clue.text: Indicator settled rejected result

parts.note: a bird that settled on a branch lit on it

indicators.note: something rejected is sent back, so the word for result is read backwards

parts.note: a sum is the result of a calculation

explanation.surface: A gauge that has settled on a reading whose outcome is then thrown out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Indicator' looks like a cryptic signal word, but here it is the definition itself: a chemistry indicator. 'settled' means alighted, as a bird does.
explanation.definitionFit: Litmus is a dye that turns red or blue to show acid or alkali, a chemical indicator.

clue.text: I support French style in London

parts.note: an arm sling is a support
ton is French for style or fashion

explanation.surface: Someone supporting French fashion trends in the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Islington is a borough of north London, so it lies within the city.

clue.text: Parasite infested King's joint

indicators.note: the parasite infests the king, here read as the parasite word holding the king's letter

parts.note: a mite is a tiny parasite
R, for Rex, is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Parasites have got into the royal anatomy.
explanation.definitionFit: A mitre is a carpentry corner joint made of two bevelled ends.

clue.text: See other arrangement made for stretcher in Oxford, say

indicators.note: an arrangement puts things into a new order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Arrangements for a hospital stretcher at the university town.
explanation.walkthrough: An Oxford here is a laced leather shoe, not the city; 'made for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden form put inside footwear to keep its shape stretches an Oxford brogue.

clue.text: Stalker had interrupted broadcaster

indicators.note: one word cutting into another breaks it apart, so it sits inside

parts.note: a sower broadcasts seed by scattering it

explanation.surface: A stalker who butted in on a radio presenter.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who follows another secretly, tailing them, is one who shadows them.

clue.text: Fate grants fool a house

parts.note: a clot is a fool
HO is the abbreviation for house

explanation.surface: Destiny hands an idiot a home.
explanation.definitionFit: Clotho is one of the three Greek Fates, who spins the thread of life.

clue.text: Colonial light lunch (not popular) creates row

indicators.note: not having something means taking it out of the word

parts.note: tiffin was the light midday meal of British India
in means popular, fashionable

explanation.surface: A colonial lunch that has gone out of favour causes a quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: TIFFIN loses IN. 'creates' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiff is a petty quarrel, a row.

clue.text: Tolerate man's forgetful ness

parts.note: to let is to allow or tolerate
he is a man; the 's is a link meaning has

explanation.surface: A man puts up with his own absent-mindedness.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the underworld river of oblivion made drinkers lose their memory, so it stands for forgetfulness.

clue.text: Lamenting dysfunctional union

indicators.note: something dysfunctional does not work properly, so these letters are disordered

explanation.surface: Grieving over a broken marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Alignment is bringing things into line together, an alliance or union.

clue.text: Show amusement about one figure of speech

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the amusement word goes round the letter for one

parts.note: to smile is to show amusement
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone laughing at a single turn of phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A simile is a comparison using like or as, a type of figurative language.

clue.text: Batting record within reason? Very well!

parts.note: in cricket the side batting is in

indicators.note: within means inside, so the record goes into the reason word

parts.note: to reason is to think
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A cricket score that seems sensible, and everything is fine.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in excellent health, thriving.

clue.text: Universal soldier, rejected in defeat, is weary

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Universal soldier, rejected in defeat, is weary' gives IGU (U + GI reversed) but nothing in 'defeat' supplies FATE around it; the outer word looks misread and no source found.
annotationWithheld.clue: Universal soldier, rejected in defeat, is weary

clue.text: Snake to settle in meadow

parts.note: a snake in the grass is a traitor, and to grass is to inform; a grass is an informer
to land is to settle down

explanation.surface: A snake slithering into a field to rest.
explanation.walkthrough: A grass is British slang for an informer, here a snake. 'to' and 'in' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Grassland is open pasture covered with grass, much like a meadow.

clue.text: Hoarding money retains German approval? That's touching!

indicators.note: retains means holds inside, so the German word sits within

parts.note: a hoarding is a billboard carrying an ad
a cent is a coin of money
ja is German for yes

explanation.surface: A billboard sum keeps a German's approval: how moving!
explanation.walkthrough: AD+CENT holds JA. 'That's' is a link; 'touching' means in contact, not moving.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjacent means next to or bordering, physically in contact.

clue.text: Canicula trails salt

parts.note: to dog someone is to trail them
a salt and a tar are both old words for a sailor

explanation.surface: A small canal trailing salt water.
explanation.definitionFit: Canicula is the Latin name of Sirius, the brightest star, in the Great Dog constellation.

clue.text: It is said to restrict precipitation

indicators.note: what is said is heard, so the word sounds like another

parts.note: to rein in is to restrict

explanation.surface: Something claimed to limit rainfall.
explanation.definitionFit: Water falling from clouds is precipitation.

clue.text: Fugitive loses article at airport

indicators.note: losing something means it is dropped from the word

parts.note: a fugitive is a runaway
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An escaped criminal drops a belonging at the airport.
explanation.definitionFit: A runway is the strip where planes take off and land.

clue.text: Strange desire to store uranium waste

indicators.note: storing something keeps it inside, so the element letter goes in
something strange is odd, so the letters are disordered

parts.note: U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: An odd wish to keep nuclear waste.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strange' rearranges DESIRE to RESIDE; 'to store' puts U inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Residue is what is left over, leftover matter or waste.

clue.text: Dispense with alternative that's over in a flash

parts.note: to mete out is to dispense
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: Doing without a backup plan that finishes in an instant.
explanation.definitionFit: A shooting star burns up across the sky within a second or so.

clue.text: His cattle disrupted the games

indicators.note: disrupted means thrown into disorder, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A farmer's herd stampedes through a sports event.
explanation.definitionFit: Track and field events make up much of the Olympic games.

clue.text: Annoyed the other fellow gets the ram

parts.note: he refers to a male person other than speaker or listener
a tup is a ram

explanation.surface: Someone is cross that another man is given the ram.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets' is a link; TUP is a British farming word for a ram.
explanation.definitionFit: Het up is an informal idiom for agitated or angry.

clue.text: Troop leader breaks into crate in station

indicators.note: breaking into a box puts something inside it

parts.note: a crate is a packing case

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A scout leader breaking into a packing box at the railway station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link; 'station' means social rank, not a railway stop.
explanation.definitionFit: Caste is social rank or class, one's station in life.

clue.text: Rent is about zero

parts.note: C, for circa, means about
love is zero in tennis

explanation.surface: Rent is roughly nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link; 'Rent' means split (cleaved), not payment.
explanation.definitionFit: Clove is a past tense of cleave, to split, so it means torn apart.

clue.text: Require English to Latin translation

indicators.note: translation turns words into another form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Needing someone to translate English into Latin.
explanation.definitionFit: To entail is to involve as a necessary consequence, to require.

clue.text: Recommend against commander breaking a tryst

indicators.note: breaking into something means getting inside it

parts.note: a tryst is a romantic date
V, for versus, means against
OC is the abbreviation for officer commanding

explanation.surface: Advice against an officer interrupting a lovers' meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: To advocate is to speak in favour of, to urge or recommend.

clue.text: Drink with Kansas leaders in Kansas

parts.note: to tope is to drink alcohol heavily
the leading two letters of the state name

explanation.surface: Raising a glass with the state's political leaders.
explanation.definitionFit: Topeka is the state capital, located within that Midwestern state.

clue.text: Supporter to give way about intention

indicators.note: about means going round, so the yielding word surrounds the aim

parts.note: to defer is to yield or give way
an end is an aim or intention

explanation.surface: A fan who yields on their purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: A defender is someone who backs or upholds a cause, a champion.
